motorModelPages.intro: The M60 axial piston motor is designed for operation on tap water and is available in 63.0 cc/rev and 70.3 cc/rev displacement options. It gives designers a high-output, oil-free rotary actuator for industrial and marine systems where contamination risk has to be engineered out.
features: Designed around water as the hydraulic medium, not oil, so leakage does not create petroleum contamination in sensitive work areas.
63.0 cc/rev and 70.3 cc/rev options let engineers match torque and flow demand without changing the overall motor class.
Rated around 160 bar / 2320 PSI for demanding rotary actuation where compact hydraulic power is still required.
Suited to water hydraulic HPUs, deck equipment, process machinery, and other systems that need clean rotary motion.

Built for clean hydraulic systems where water is the working medium and petroleum leakage is unacceptable.
Designed for boosted inlet operation with mechanical seal construction for larger system integration.
Appropriate for high-load equipment in marine, infrastructure, desalination, and industrial environments.
